_readme: Lens Finder chat trial (Mark, 3 Nov 2026). Copy to config/lenschat.json (git-ignored) to switch it on. The chat runs only when enabled is true AND an API key is present (environment CEC_LENSCHAT_API_KEY, or key_file - keep that file OUTSIDE every repo). Spend is capped at A$10 for life by the ledger file (create it once with: python -m hub.lenschat init-ledger). Mark-only: requests from the server itself, or from the device addresses in allow_ips. practice_weekdays: 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday; the trial ends after 7 of these days from the first question.
